scope: one frozen contiguous categorical motif, transferred across disjoint windows of fixed-site snapshots
fit: use equal leading site prefixes; enumerate patterns of width 2–6 and leftmost disjoint placements within each frame, with at least two matches across training; admit only a strict training gain, charging the dictionary once and comparing against the sum of independently selected five-family baselines for the training frames
test: encode each later prefix as its own frame with the same frozen motif and the same Huffman comparator fitted on the training prefixes; charge each model definition once and retain zero-match tests and absent training dictionaries
controls: hold test label counts fixed while changing order in one later frame; mutate the guard, unused sites and tail; exercise candidates spanning snapshot edges and controls with no admitted motif
limits: 4096 symbols in each aggregate scored window, exact serialized cost and synthetic temporal transfer checks only
